copy.tagline: 管理无服务器 MySQL 数据库，支持分支与部署请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 PlanetScale 上管理 MySQL 数据库
copy.tagline_en: Manage serverless MySQL databases with branching and deploy requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage MySQL databases on PlanetScale

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你用 HTTP 连接 PlanetScale 的 MySQL 数据库，执行参数化查询、事务，并通过分支和部署请求管理数据库结构变更。
howto.when: 当你提到 PlanetScale、@planetscale/database、数据库分支、部署请求等关键词，或要求从边缘/无服务器环境查询 MySQL 时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 @planetscale/database 连接数据库并查询用户表。
say.note: Claude 会生成连接和查询代码。

say.text: 创建一个部署请求，把新列加到生产分支。
say.note: Claude 会指导你通过分支和部署请求流程。

say.text: 写一个事务，从账户A转账到账户B。
say.note: Claude 会生成带事务的代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you connect to PlanetScale MySQL databases via HTTP, execute parameterized queries and transactions, and manage schema changes using branches and deploy requests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention PlanetScale, @planetscale/database, database branching, deploy requests, or ask to query MySQL from edge/serverless environments.

say_en.text: Help me connect to the database using @planetscale/database and query the users table.
say_en.note: Claude will generate connection and query code.

say_en.text: Create a deploy request to add a new column to the production branch.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through branching and deploy request workflow.

say_en.text: Write a transaction to transfer funds from account A to account B.
say_en.note: Claude will generate code with a transaction.
